#include <SFML/Graphics.hpp>
#include <string>

enum GameState{
    MENU,
    PLAYING
};
int main(){
    float speedBall=300.0f;
    float speedCard=200.0f;
    sf::Clock clock;
    GameState currentState=MENU;
    sf::RenderWindow window(
        sf::VideoMode(800, 600),
        "Game"
    );
    sf::Texture texture;
    if(!texture.loadFromFile("R.png")){
        return -1;
    }
    sf::Sprite sprite;
    sprite.setTexture(texture);
    sprite.setPosition(300.f, 200.f);
    sprite.setScale(0.2f, 0.2f);
    sf::RectangleShape card;
    card.setFillColor(sf::Color::Blue);
    card.setPosition(400, 300);
    card.setSize(sf::Vector2f(100.f, 100.f));
    bool cardBlue=true;

    sf::CircleShape ball;
    ball.setFillColor(sf::Color::Green);
    ball.setPosition(100.f, 100.f);
    ball.setRadius(50.f);
    bool wasColliding=false;
    bool isColliding=false;
    bool isBlue=true;
    sf::Font font;
    font.loadFromFile("Roboto-Regular.ttf");

    sf::Text collisiontext;
    collisiontext.setFont(font);
    collisiontext.setString("Collision Demo");
    collisiontext.setCharacterSize(30);
    collisiontext.setFillColor(sf::Color::White);
    collisiontext.setPosition(250.f, 20.f);

    sf::Text cardtext;
    cardtext.setFont(font);
    cardtext.setString("Card: (400, 300)");
    cardtext.setCharacterSize(30);
    cardtext.setFillColor(sf::Color::White);
    cardtext.setPosition(400.f, 30.f);

    sf::Text balltext;
    balltext.setFont(font);
    balltext.setString("Ball: (100, 100)");
    balltext.setCharacterSize(30);
    balltext.setFillColor(sf::Color::White);
    balltext.setPosition(20.f, 20.f);

    sf::Text fpsText;
    fpsText.setFont(font);
    fpsText.setCharacterSize(30);
    fpsText.setFillColor(sf::Color::White);
    fpsText.setPosition(20, 20);


    while(window.isOpen()){
        float dt=clock.restart().asSeconds();
        float fps=1.0f/dt;
        fpsText.setString("FPS: "+std::to_string((int)fps));
        sf::Event event;
        while(window.pollEvent(event)){
            if(event.type==sf::Event::Closed){
                window.close();
            }
            if(event.type==sf::Event::MouseButtonPressed && event.mouseButton.button==sf::Mouse::Left){
                sf::Vector2i mousePos=sf::Mouse::getPosition(window);
                sf::Vector2f worldPos=window.mapPixelToCoords(mousePos);
                if(card.getGlobalBounds().contains(worldPos)){
                    if(cardBlue){
                        card.setFillColor(sf::Color::White);
                        cardBlue=false;
                    }else{
                        card.setFillColor(sf::Color::Blue);
                        cardBlue=true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::Left)){
            card.move(-speedCard*dt, 0.f);
        }
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::Right)){
            card.move(speedCard*dt, 0.f);
        }
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::Up)){
            card.move(0.f, -speedCard*dt);
        }
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::Down)){
            card.move(0.f, speedCard*dt);
        }
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::A)){
            ball.move(-speedBall*dt, 0.f);
        }
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::D)){
            ball.move(speedBall*dt, 0.f);
        }
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::W)){
            ball.move(0.f, -speedBall*dt);
        }
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::S)){
            ball.move(0.f, speedBall*dt);
        }
        isColliding=ball.getGlobalBounds().intersects(
            card.getGlobalBounds()
        );
        if(isColliding && !wasColliding){
            if(isBlue){
                card.setFillColor(sf::Color::White);
                collisiontext.setString("COLLISION");
                isBlue=false;
            }else{
                card.setFillColor(sf::Color::Blue);
                collisiontext.setString("Collision Demo");
                isBlue=true;
            }
        }
        balltext.setString("Ball: ("+std::to_string((int)ball.getPosition().x)+", "
        +std::to_string((int)ball.getPosition().y)+")");
        cardtext.setString("Card: ("+std::to_string((int)card.getPosition().x)+", "+std::to_string((int)card.getPosition().y)+")");
        if(!isColliding){
            wasColliding=false;
        }else{
            wasColliding=true;
        }
        switch(currentState){
            case MENU:
            if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::Enter)){
                currentState=PLAYING;
            }
            window.clear(sf::Color::Blue);
        break;

        case PLAYING:
        if(sf::Keyboard::isKeyPressed(sf::Keyboard::Escape)){
            currentState=MENU;
        }
        window.clear(sf::Color::Green);
        break;
    }
        sprite.rotate(0.05f);
        window.draw(fpsText);
        window.draw(ball);
        window.draw(card);  
        window.draw(cardtext);
        window.draw(balltext);
        window.draw(sprite);
        window.draw(collisiontext);
        window.display();
    }
    return 0;
}
